feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 3:57pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 16 May 2026 at 4:05pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Outbreaks of rain clearing this evening with a few bright intervals developing as the light to moderate southwest wind veers westerly. Mostly dry with clear spells overnight and temperatures no lower than 6 Celsius.

Generally dry and bright tomorrow morning with sunny intervals, but getting showers during the afternoon and evening. Moderate to fresh west-southwest winds; top temperature about 13°C.


##Outlook##

Dry with bright or sunny spells on Monday, then cloud increasing later ahead of a band of rain arriving at night and into early Tuesday with a strengthening southerly wind.
